Vendor coverage rates, kit sizes and mix ratios below belong to their publishers on the day tested; they illustrate how public estimators multiply and are never Calculiva defaults. Every thickness, solids figure, loss allowance, kit size, ratio and broadcast rate preloaded in the calculator is a hypothetical exercise to be replaced by the product's technical data sheet.
